raw_response: {"diagnosis": "silver_transactions derives txn_date from CAST(ingest_ts AS DATE), which is the delivery batch date (always the day after the transaction, at 02:00). The txn_date column is meant to be the transaction date, as the DATE_CONSISTENCY monitor checks, so every POSTED row (4630) is off by one day and the gold tables inherit the wrong dates. Changing the derivation to CAST(txn_ts AS DATE) restores the column's meaning without changing any output columns or touching raw data.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(txn_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
